title: Paneer tikka wrap with peppers and yoghurt
steps: Dice the paneer and mix it with 50 g yoghurt, garam masala, paprika, lemon juice and salt.
Cut the pepper and onion into strips.
Fry the paneer and vegetables in the oil in a hot pan for 6–8 minutes until the paneer is coloured.
Stir the remaining yoghurt with mint, warm the tortillas, fill with lettuce, paneer, vegetables and mint yoghurt and roll up.
